plugins.name: pi-security
plugins.description: Pi Security workflows for Claude Code and Cowork: investigate findings, review security posture, fetch remediation guidance, start design reviews, submit Markdown reports, and query secure-development playbooks through Pi's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: ingest-markdown-report
skills.description: Submit a security report to Pi as inline Markdown with a .md or .markdown filename, after explicit user confirmation. Reports the queued ingestion workflow state truthfully.
headings: Submit a Markdown security report to Pi
skills.description_zh: 在用户明确确认后，以带 .md 或 .markdown 文件名的内联 Markdown 向 Pi 提交安全报告，并如实报告已排队摄取工作流的状态。

skills.name: investigate-finding
skills.description: Investigate Pi Security findings - list, locate, explain, summarize, or compare findings by FND-XXX ID, UUID, or Pi finding URL. Read-only; uses Pi's hosted MCP tools as evidence.
skills.description_zh: 通过 FND-XXX ID、UUID 或 Pi 发现链接列举、定位、解释、汇总或比较 Pi Security 发现。仅只读调查，以托管 MCP 工具结果为证据。

skills.name: remediation-guidance
skills.description: Fetch existing Pi remediation guidance for a finding or an SBOM package, and optionally prepare a missing package remediation plan after explicit user confirmation.
skills.description_zh: 获取 Pi 针对安全发现或 SBOM 包已有的修复建议；如缺少包修复计划，可在用户明确确认后准备计划。

skills.name: review-security-posture
skills.description: Review Pi Security posture - threat-model application and section context combined with Code Gatekeeper PR and issue reviews. Read-only; uses Pi's hosted MCP tools as evidence.
skills.description_zh: 结合威胁模型的应用及章节上下文、Code Gatekeeper PR 和问题审查，评估 Pi Security 安全状况。仅只读，以托管 MCP 结果为证据。

skills.name: secure-development-playbook
skills.description: Get repo-specific Pi secure-development guidance for a stable engineering task, optionally retrieve necessary threat-model context, and record playbook feedback after confirmation.
skills.description_zh: 为稳定的工程任务获取仓库专属 Pi 安全开发指引，按需读取威胁模型上下文，并在确认后记录指引反馈。

skills.name: security-design-review
skills.description: Start a Pi Security design review from a supported Confluence or Notion document URL or from inline Markdown, after explicit user confirmation. No attachments, local files, or binaries.
skills.name_hint: 安全 · 设计 · 评审
skills.description_zh: 在用户明确确认后，从受支持的 Confluence、Notion 文档链接或内联 Markdown 启动 Pi Security 设计评审。不支持附件、本地文件或二进制。
